dz: 经过十年休战后,德意志国王亨利·福勒(英语:Henry the Fowler)在通斯特特河附近的里亚德战役中击败了一支匈牙利军队.
de: After a ten-year truce, German King Henry the Fowler defeats a Hungarian army at the Battle of Riade near the Unstrut river.
